query: SELECT id, gallon_number, liters_purchased/100 as liters, amount_paid/100 as amount, price_per_liter/100 as price_per_liter, purchased_at FROM fuel_purchases WHERE gallon_number = 1 ORDER BY purchased_at DESC LIMIT 10;
